paper: Relative Advantage Debiasing for Watch-Time Prediction in Short-Video Recommendation
method: Map play time to train-only user- and video-conditional empirical quantiles, then learn the relative-preference signal in a separate stage.
fit: Distinct from watch_ratio and CWM: it removes both user watch-habit and item-duration/popularity confounding.
smallest_ablation: Completed: fused user/video watch quantiles as a DeepFM auxiliary target, alpha-zero control, pure RAD-head ranking, and train-only head-mix scan.
risk: The alpha-zero control outperformed the RAD auxiliary on both tiers; pure RAD-head ranking scored 0.583969 internally and every held-out residual fold regressed. Do not repeat without a materially different stage-1 estimator or backbone.

paper: UMRE: A Unified Monotonic Transformation for Ranking Ensemble in Recommender Systems
method: Learn monotonic transformations of diverse objective scores, then fuse them with lightweight personalized weights.
fit: The frozen champion relies on linear rank consensus; RRF failed, but learned monotonic score-region weighting is mathematically different.
smallest_ablation: Completed a leak-free UMRE-lite screen with aligned out-of-time pointwise-FM, pairwise-FM, and DeepFM streams, train-only isotonic transforms, and a matched regularized linear consensus.
risk: The monotonic fusion lost 0.000051 primary and 0.000121 GAUC to the matched control, so no personalized gate or confirmation was allowed.

method: Optimize direct YetiRank NDCG or StochasticRank NDCG@5 instead of pairwise YetiRank.
fit: Targets the official top-five metric without changing the frozen batch-slate features.
smallest_ablation: Completed with YetiRank:mode=NDCG;top=5 and StochasticRank:metric=NDCG;top=5, both residual-initialized and from-scratch where appropriate.
risk: Both objectives gained about 0.003-0.004 on April 20-21 but reversed below 0.6119 on April 22-28; held-out residual folds disagreed.

paper: DeepFM: A Factorization-Machine based Neural Network for CTR Prediction
method: Add nested 25/50/75 percent progress-to-long-view binary auxiliary heads and discard them at inference.
fit: Gives near-threshold watch outcomes denser ordered supervision than a single hard long_view label.
smallest_ablation: Completed with temporal epoch selection, full refit, global residual audit, and an 18-second long-video gate.
risk: The screen reached 0.615249, but the fixed confirmation blend scored 0.612857 and both residual audits retained regressing folds.

paper: CAAFE: Context-Aware Automated Feature Engineering for Tabular Datasets
method: Join organizer user attributes and learn profile-item interactions in CatBoost and DeepFM.
fit: The starter encoder omits all user profile columns, making this a genuine semantic feature ablation.
smallest_ablation: Completed with profile CatBoost, profile plus user-ID CatBoost, one-seed profile DeepFM, low-history routing, and a three-seed profile ensemble.
risk: The best fixed micro-gain was 0.612877, but held-out user folds regressed; do not promote or repeat without a materially different validation protocol.

paper: Bayesian Personalized Ranking from Implicit Feedback
method: Add a small same-user positive-negative softplus loss to pointwise DeepFM, select epochs by GAUC on a later temporal window, and refit on the full training period.
fit: The official GAUC is positive-count-weighted within-user AUC, so sampling one logged negative per usable positive closely matches its comparison weighting while BCE anchors pointwise behavior.
smallest_ablation: Completed a random-stream-matched pointwise control and pair weights 0.05 and 0.01. Weight 0.01 improved the train-only screen by +0.000057 GAUC and +0.000120 nDCG@5, then scored 0.612856984 at confirmation versus the 0.612858057 champion.
risk: The four-fold residual audit selected inconsistent negative weights, three held-out folds regressed, and the fixed residual lost 0.00005275 primary. Do not promote or repeat this loss without a materially different sampler or backbone.

paper: Conservative Doubly Robust Learning for Debiased Recommendation
method: Filter uncertain error imputations in doubly robust learning using their estimated mean and variance.
fit: Directly evaluated on KuaiRand with biased training and random-exposure evaluation data.
smallest_ablation: Only after rebuilding a valid random-log screen: compare DR against conservative uncertainty filtering.
risk: This challenge validates on standard logs, so optimizing toward the random-log distribution can reduce the official score.

paper: SetRank: Learning a Permutation-Invariant Ranking Model for Information Retrieval
method: Encode a candidate set with permutation-invariant self-attention before producing item scores.
fit: Matches the evaluator's whole-user slate, particularly long slates where nDCG degrades.
smallest_ablation: Completed one low-rank permutation-invariant self-attention residual against a matched mean-pool control with fixed pointwise BCE and temporal selection.
risk: Attention lost 0.000008 primary and 0.000028 nDCG@5 on the locked train-only screen, so confirmation was not allowed.

paper: From RankNet to LambdaRank to LambdaMART: An Overview
method: Gradient-boosted trees with metric-weighted pair gradients.
smallest_ablation: None: CatBoost YetiRank and XGBoost LambdaMART were already audited.
risk: Best XGBoost seed was 0.611949 standalone and selected zero residual.

paper: Counteracting Duration Bias in Video Recommendation via Counterfactual Watch Time
method: Model censored watch time counterfactually rather than treating completion as an exact preference value.
fit: Published KuaiRand relevance-ranking gains motivated the existing survival experiments.
risk: CWM likelihood, censored mixture survival, and duration-regime variants already failed stable promotion.

paper: Modeling Task Relationships in Multi-task Learning with Multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts
method: Use task-specific gates over shared experts for multiple feedback signals.
smallest_ablation: Only revisit with a new target such as RAD quantiles.
risk: Generic multi-task and MMoE controls have already regressed.

paper: MaskNet: Introducing Feature-Wise Multiplication to CTR Ranking Models by Instance-Guided Mask
method: Use instance-guided multiplicative masks to learn context-dependent feature interactions before the pointwise prediction tower.
fit: Tests a dynamic interaction mechanism distinct from the exhausted DCN and AutoInt branches.
smallest_ablation: Completed a matched MaskNet-versus-plain-MLP temporal screen, locked confirmation, champion residual, and four actual-user-ID folds.
risk: A +0.000449 screen gain reversed to -0.000080 at confirmation; the residual micro-gain was only 0.0000003 and three of four folds regressed.

paper: FinalMLP: An Enhanced Two-Stream MLP Model for CTR Prediction
method: Fuse two feature streams with a gated low-rank bilinear interaction layer.
fit: Provides a strong two-stream interaction ablation while retaining stable pointwise BCE.
smallest_ablation: Completed a matched bilinear-versus-additive screen, locked confirmation, frozen-champion residual, and four user folds.
risk: A +0.000756 screen gain reversed to -0.000017 at confirmation; the fixed residual lost primary and all four held-out folds regressed.

paper: The Use of MMR, Diversity-Based Reranking for Reordering Documents and Producing Summaries
method: Apply an outcome-free author, music, type, and tag redundancy penalty inside the frozen champion's top ten.
fit: Directly tests whether local content redundancy, rather than score calibration, limits top-five ranking quality.
smallest_ablation: Selected lambda 0.08 on train-only dates and applied the exact locked reranker at confirmation without retuning.
risk: The global confirmation micro-gain was +0.000013 primary, but one fold lost nDCG and another lost GAUC; it failed the predeclared all-fold all-metric gate.

paper: Bayesian Personalized Ranking from Implicit Feedback
method: Mine hard positive-negative pairs whose frozen scores are nearly tied, emphasizing comparisons that can alter the top ten.
fit: Targets only uncertain local orderings instead of disturbing globally calibrated pointwise scores.
smallest_ablation: Fit the residual on early April 14, select its magnitude on late April 14, and lock it for April 15-21.
risk: The zero-preferring selector chose magnitude 0.0; the candidate changed no locked metric and was not confirmed.

paper: A General Approximation Framework for Direct Optimization of Information Retrieval Measures
method: Add a bounded neural residual trained with pointwise BCE plus a low-weight differentiable top-five ranking objective.
fit: Isolates an nDCG-aware gradient while preserving the frozen pointwise base and strict group-memory limits.
smallest_ablation: Compared alpha 0.02 with an exact alpha-zero neural control, then isolated candidate-minus-control as a locked differential and audited a fixed 5% champion blend.
risk: The differential replicated with +0.000221 primary against its confirmation base, but the champion blend lost 0.0000019 primary and two held-out folds regressed.

paper: Adaptive Factorization Network: Learning Adaptive-Order Feature Interactions
method: Use logarithmic neural transformation layers to learn data-dependent interaction orders without explicitly enumerating feature crosses.
fit: Offers an interaction geometry distinct from the rejected attention, cross, masking, and bilinear families while preserving pointwise BCE.
smallest_ablation: Compare a small AFN residual with an embedding-and-MLP control under identical seeds, temporal selection, and a bounded CPU budget.
risk: Log-space transforms can be numerically fragile, and another neural interaction family may repeat the same train-only optimism seen in MaskNet and FinalMLP.
